security_summary: First-priority blanket lien on substantially all personal property of the Borrower (accounts and contract rights; inventory and materials; machinery, vehicles, and equipment; deposit accounts and securities accounts; books and records; insurance proceeds and other proceeds) per the executed Guaranty and Security Agreement (effective 2025-01-15), guaranteed by Orinth Vale Field Services, LLC, PLUS a separate first-priority security interest in registered/unregistered intellectual property (ORINTH VALE trademark application, VALEGRID service mark application, and related domain names) per the executed Intellectual Property Security Agreement (effective 2025-01-15). Controlled deposit accounts at Cairn National Bank (operating account ending 1842, payroll account ending 7710) per the executed Information Certificate. Source: executed Guaranty and Security Agreement, executed Intellectual Property Security Agreement, executed Information Certificate, executed Credit Agreement (Initial Closing, 01 Legal/Executed/Initial Closing).
_ip_collateral_note: The IP Security Agreement's pledged trademarks/service marks/domains have no distinct 'Intangible Assets' line on this borrower's Balance Sheet (only a catch-all 'Other Assets' row, not itemized) -- so IP is NOT included as a pledged_components tier below (there is no model row to track it against). Noted in security_summary for completeness; the Collateral box coverage math is therefore conservative (excludes an asset class the lender does in fact have a lien on).
_no_goodwill_note: Borrower's Balance Sheet carries no goodwill line (only a catch-all 'Other Assets' row), so no goodwill-tier component or 'ex-goodwill' cut is defined -- 'All pledged assets' and 'Ex-goodwill assets' would be identical here, so only one all-inclusive cut is defined below.
